g.text: India, China, Bangladesh, Afghanistan, Philippines: the stable top-5 origin cluster (53 M foreign-born stock in UN DESA

g.text: 2024). Cumulative STOCK, not annual flow. Afghanistan's 7.5 M is overwhelmingly refugees and post-2021 displaced
